clue.text: Show light sauce

parts.note: a light is a pane or opening in a wall, a window
a salad sauce such as vinaigrette is a dressing

explanation.surface: A menu note about a light sauce on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: Window dressing is an outward display meant to impress, mere show without substance.

clue.text: Butterfly unfortunate with heart of Pinkerton, a naval officer

indicators.note: unfortunate letters are ill-placed, so the word with and the extra letter get rearranged
the heart of a word is its central letter, here the fifth of nine

parts.note: an admiral is a senior officer in a navy

explanation.surface: Madama Butterfly, unlucky in love with Pinkerton, the US naval officer of Puccini's opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunate' rearranges WITH plus E, the middle letter of Pinkerton, into WHITE. Lieutenant Pinkerton is the American naval officer who deserts Butterfly in Puccini's opera, so the surface almost defines the whole.
explanation.definitionFit: The white admiral is a woodland butterfly of Europe and Asia, dark brown with white bands.

clue.text: Now I see container from the south for Tex-Mex food

indicators.note: in a down clue, reading from the south means going upwards, so the pieces run backwards

parts.note: oh is the exclamation of someone who now understands
a can is a metal container

explanation.surface: Someone spots a box of Tex-Mex snacks arriving from the southern border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the south' turns the whole of OH CAN upwards to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nachos are tortilla chips topped with melted cheese, a staple Tex-Mex snack.

clue.text: Part of church in need of repair for a long time

indicators.note: something in need of repair is broken, so these letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A church feature has been crying out for repairs for ages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in need of repair' rearranges FORALONG into ORGANLOF, before the T.
explanation.definitionFit: An organ loft is the gallery in a church where the organ stands, one part of the building.

clue.text: Artist's underwear

definitions.meaning: an artist who draws is a drawer
an old word for knickers or underpants

explanation.surface: The painter's knickers.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawers are both people who sketch and an old-fashioned word for underpants.

clue.text: Wood — is it turning up in volcano?

parts.note: elm is a timber, a type of wood

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means read upwards, so it runs backwards

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a piece of timber is turning up inside a volcano.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses only the word it, not 'is'; in a down clue the reversed letters read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: El Misti is a dormant volcano in southern Peru, overlooking the city of Arequipa.

clue.text: Laxative for Formula One champion

definitions.meaning: a plant extract taken to ease constipation
Ayrton ... was a Brazilian racing driver, three times world champion

explanation.surface: A purgative named for a racing driver.
explanation.definitionFit: Senna is both a purgative plant extract and the surname of Brazilian racing champion Ayrton Senna.

clue.text: Al most?

parts.note: the short name Al is the word all lacking its last letter

explanation.surface: Is Al the most?
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: nearly all of ALL gives AL; and 'most' defines it, the question mark flagging the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Most of something means the greater part of it, almost the whole.

clue.text: Not revealing identity in small part

parts.note: a cog is a minor part in a machine, as in a small cog in a big wheel

explanation.surface: A spy keeping their identity secret in a minor role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in small part' also hints that the answer is a short form of incognito.
explanation.definitionFit: Incog is an informal shortening of incognito, meaning in disguise with identity hidden.

clue.text: Foreigner making Marianne unfaithful?

indicators.note: unfaithful means not true to the original, so the name's letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Marianne's infidelity with a foreigner.
explanation.definitionFit: An Armenian is a native of Armenia, a foreigner from a British point of view.

clue.text: Playtime in January

parts.note: split as play plus time in January: a Shakespeare comedy that shares its name with an evening early in the year

explanation.surface: Theatre time in the new year.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'Playtime' into two words: Play, a Shakespeare comedy, and a time in January, the eve of Epiphany.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelfth Night is a Shakespeare comedy and also the eve of Epiphany in early January.

clue.text: Have no uncertainty — speak out!

annotationWithheld.why: Have no uncertainty — speak out! (7): ENOUNCE runs across havE NO UNCErtainty, but no clue word signals the extraction (the blogger found none either); Have would have to be fodder and indicator at once

clue.text: Down from a bird

definitions.meaning: to down a drink is to gulp it

explanation.surface: Feathers falling from a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: To swallow is to down food or drink, and a swallow is a migrating songbird.

clue.text: What's come to light? Very deficient dance music

indicators.note: deficient means lacking, so the next word is taken away

parts.note: a discovery is something newly brought to light
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking what has emerged, and dismissing some feeble dance music.
explanation.definitionFit: Disco is the 1970s style of dance music played in discotheques.

clue.text: Alone with France and Ireland in battle

indicators.note: the French and Irish pieces go in between the letters of the word for alone

parts.note: solo means alone, without others
F is the international vehicle code for France
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A lone soldier fighting alongside the French and Irish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts France and Ireland inside the word for alone; Erin is a poetic name solvers meet often.
explanation.definitionFit: Solferino was an 1859 battle in northern Italy where France and Piedmont beat Austria.

clue.text: US city turning up in atlas

indicators.note: turning letters over and around puts them in a new order

explanation.surface: An American city appearing on a map.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' rearranges UP IN ATLAS; 'turning up' reads as appearing, the false path.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Paul is the capital of Minnesota, twin city of Minneapolis.

clue.text: Something with a very short life in the German capital? Who Do You Think You Are Kidding, Mr Hitler?

definitions.text: Who Do You Think You Are Kidding, Mr Hitler?

indicators.note: the particle goes inside the other two pieces

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the capital letter of German is G

parts.words: Something with a very short life
parts.note: a meson is a subatomic particle that decays in a fraction of a second

explanation.surface: A fleeting thing in Berlin, then a mocking wartime song title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the particle inside the other pieces. The song was the title tune of Dad's Army, a BBC sitcom about Britain's wartime Home Guard.
explanation.definitionFit: That song, sung by Bud Flanagan, opened every episode of the BBC sitcom Dad's Army as its signature tune.

clue.text: I'm going to a kid that's uncomfortable

parts.note: I'll is the contraction for I will, I'm going to
to kid someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: A promise to approach a young goat who seems uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill at ease describes someone uneasy or awkward, not comfortable.

clue.text: A northern port somewhere in Hampshire

parts.note: Dover is the English Channel ferry port in Kent

explanation.surface: Looking for a northern harbour in a southern county.
explanation.walkthrough: Hampshire is a county on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Andover is a market town in the north of Hampshire.

clue.text: Red nose running back

indicators.note: a running nose suggests letters flowing into a new order

explanation.surface: A red, runny nose on the way back.
explanation.definitionFit: To back a cause or candidate is to support it, a synonym of endorse.

clue.text: Story that's going round about Conservative success

indicators.note: the reversed story is placed around the abbreviation
going round means the word is turned back to front

parts.note: a tale is a story

explanation.surface: A rumour circulating about a Tory triumph.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's going round' turns TALE into ELAT, and 'about' puts that around C.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclat is brilliant success or acclaim, as in a performance done with great eclat.

clue.text: The Bible was not infallible, it's alleged

parts.note: AV is the Authorized Version, the King James Bible
to err is to make a mistake, so erred means was fallible

explanation.surface: A claim that scripture made mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to assert or declare, so averred is a synonym of alleged.

clue.text: Minister not completing one side of document

indicators.note: not completing means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a rector is a parish minister in the Church of England

explanation.surface: A clergyman fails to finish a page of paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: The recto is the right-hand page of a book, or the front side of a sheet.

clue.text: City drive needs buggy

parts.note: Dr is the street-name abbreviation for drive

indicators.note: buggy means full of bugs or faults, so the word is scrambled

explanation.surface: A city's streets demand a buggy ride.
explanation.definitionFit: Dresden is the capital city of Saxony in eastern Germany.

clue.text: Bunch of flowers first for Dionysus?

definitions.meaning: flowers read as things that flow, rivers, splitting into many channels at a river mouth
the Greek letter that begins the god's name in Greek

explanation.surface: A bouquet as the first offering to the god of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A delta is the fan of channels at a river mouth and the Greek letter D.

clue.text: Fighter may provide this 'eadscarf

definitions.meaning: protection given from the sky by fighter aircraft
a headscarf is a hair cover, said Cockney-style with the h dropped

explanation.surface: A fighter plane provides protection, or a Cockney's headscarf does.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney speech drops the H, as in 'eadscarf for headscarf, so a hair cover loses its H too.
explanation.definitionFit: Air cover is protection from fighter aircraft for ground or sea forces.

clue.text: Old standard? Colditz, for example

parts.note: a standard is a flag or banner

explanation.surface: Colditz as an old-fashioned standard of prison.
explanation.walkthrough: Colditz was a German castle used as a POW camp for officers in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oflag was a German prison camp for officers, short for Offizierslager.

clue.text: NCO sure to glare in mess?

definitions.text: NCO sure to glare in mess?

indicators.note: in a mess means jumbled up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sergeant certain to scowl at the soldiers in the dining hall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in mess' rearranges NCO SURE TO GLARE; a mess is also a military dining room.
explanation.definitionFit: A colour sergeant is a senior non-commissioned officer in British infantry or the Royal Marines.
